data.body: Gerrit 1575: LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 2 advisory findings, 0 blocking). First CI run (GitHub Actions 31338947918) came back red on ONE matrix job — `pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)` — with `tests/interfaces/store/test_event_append_index_lock.py::test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds` failing on `fatal: unable to write new index file`. That is a store index-lock timing flake with no relationship to this change (this change touches only `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_rate_limit_sweep_heldout.py`; every other job, including ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 pytest and lint+type-check, was green). Posted `recheck` per AGENTS.md rather than amending.
